    • 字段详细资料

      • channelName

        @NameInMap(value="ChannelName")
public String channelName

        The name of the replication channel, which is used to identify the replication task.

        example:

        replication-channel-001

      • dbInstanceId

        @NameInMap(value="DbInstanceId")
public String dbInstanceId

        Instance ID of the instance. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query instance ID.

        This parameter is required.

        example:

        rm-bp1234567890abcdef

      • masterHost

        @NameInMap(value="MasterHost")
public String masterHost

        The host address of the primary database. Both IP addresses and domain names are supported.

        This parameter is required.

        example:

        192.168.1.100

      • masterPassword

        @NameInMap(value="MasterPassword")
public String masterPassword

        The password of the primary database used to authenticate the replication user. The password must be Base64-encoded in advance.

        This parameter is required.

        example:

        U2VjdXJlUGFzczEyMyE=

      • masterPort

        @NameInMap(value="MasterPort")
public Integer masterPort

        The port number of the primary database. Typically, the port is 3306 for MySQL.

        This parameter is required.

        example:

        3306

      • masterUser

        @NameInMap(value="MasterUser")
public String masterUser

        The username of the primary database used to establish a replication connection.

        This parameter is required.

        example:

        repl_user

      • ownerId

        @NameInMap(value="OwnerId")
public Long ownerId

        阿里云账号ID，用于指定资源的所有者

        example:

        1234567890123456

      • regionId

        @NameInMap(value="RegionId")
public String regionId

        The region ID of the instance.

        This parameter is required.

        example:

        cn-hangzhou
